headline: You have a fever and a bad smell from the wound – please call your surgical team today.

reasons.finding: feeling hot and achy since last night
reddish-brown bruising and streaking beyond the incision line on photo
wound edges appear together, not apart

steps: Call your surgical team now to report the fever, bad smell, and pain.
Keep the dressing clean and dry; do not remove it.
Monitor your temperature and any changes in the wound's appearance.
Seek immediate help if you develop severe breathlessness, confusion, or the wound opens.
message_to_team: I have a fever of 38.1°C, a bad smell under my dressing, and my pain is 7/10. The wound looks closed but there is reddish streaking beyond the stitches. Please advise what to do next.

second_check.note: Fever and foul odor suggest possible infection requiring prompt surgical review.

photo_words: The wound is closed with black interrupted stitches (sutures), with tied ends visible along the line. There is reddish-brown bruising and streaking beyond the incision line, including a vertical streak on the right; no clear distance is visible. Swelling is not clearly visible. Reddish-brown crust and blood staining are present at several suture sites; no other discharge is visible. The wound edges appear together, not apart.

events.text: Nemotron Super is weighing the answers against the baseline.
Nemotron Ultra is double-checking the alarm.
